resolution: Folded the cookie-cutter / piece-by-piece architecture into the texture packer so the downstream image-to-image flow needs no re-pack. Per USER: save each UV island's OUTLINE as a cookie cutter, so a single piece can be sent to an image model, the result masked to the silhouette (overshoot is fine), and scaled back into its atlas slot — everything piece by piece. Implemented at the foundation: textureize.ts's TextureIsland carries, per island, its outline (the cookie cutter, in atlas texels) + its normalized uv + its slot rect + a stable color — exactly the data the mask->generate->clip->composite step consumes. The packer is global (whole scene) so every island is an addressable independent piece. The actual image-to-image call + masked composite + hand-painting is Phase 5d (documented in PLAYBOOK Part 5.6a), deliberately deferred but architected: because the outlines + slots are saved, 5d builds on top without re-packing. textureize 6/6 (asserts every island carries an outline).
